messages.subject: Re: Plug in ESW for densities
parts:
Josee:

Are you describing an analysis using the density surface modelling (DSM)=20
engine in Distance 6? It is possible to use DSM by providing estimates=20
of the detection probability for each object detected. Those estimates=20
of detection probability can be gotten from some other analysis. =20
However, it is not necessarily the case that detection probability (or=20
ESW) is necessarily constant over space. It is common to use covariates=20
such as sea state, glare, observer experience to model variability in=20
detectability.
